faq.question: Is there a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Pro comes with a 7-day free trial on your first upgrade. The trial covers the $12.99 monthly fee; usage above the included quota is billed as you send.

faq.question: How does pay-as-you-send work?
faq.answer: Pro is $12.99 every 30 days and includes 3,000 emails and 3,000 web push. Above that you pay per 1,000 messages actually sent — from $1.50 per 1,000 emails and $0.30 per 1,000 web push, getting cheaper as volume grows. Your list size never changes the price.

faq.question: Can I cap my monthly spend?
faq.answer: Yes. You choose a monthly maximum for emails and web push in the app. It's a ceiling, not a charge: when you reach it, sending pauses and you get notified. Pro goes up to 2,000,000 emails and 5,000,000 web push a month — contact us if you need more.

faq.question: Are usage charges refundable?
faq.answer: Usage charges are for messages already delivered, so they're not refundable — unless a send failed because of a technical problem on our side.

faq.question: Who handles billing?
faq.answer: Shopify. Charges appear on your regular Shopify invoice, and you can cancel any time from the app.
